answer: Gate payouts behind a terrace of trust: an agent climbs one step only when peers already on the step above attest its work, and each attester may lift just two newcomers per epoch. A sybil gale of ten thousand fresh keys piles up on the bottom step, because attester slots are scarce and spending one on a clone gets the voucher slashed. Like a lotus rooted in mud, standing grows slowly from real links, so flooding the network with copies buys idle names, not income.
